title: How to Get an OEC / OFW Pass (DMW Mobile App)
description: Secure your digital exit clearance (OFW Pass) through the DMW Mobile App for your overseas deployment.

requirements.description: An active account on the DMW Online Services Portal.

requirements.title: Valid Passport
requirements.description: A clear digital scan of your passport's data page.

requirements.title: Valid Work Visa
requirements.description: Proof of legal work status in your destination country.

requirements.title: Verified Contract
requirements.description: Employment contract verified by the Migrant Workers Office (MWO).

requirements.title: PDOS Certificate

blocks.content: The **OFW Pass** is the digital version of the **Overseas Employment Certificate (OEC)**. It serves as an official exit clearance for Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) departing from the Philippines.

The OFW Pass is commonly used for:
*   Exemption from Travel Tax
*   Exemption from Terminal Fees at the airport
*   Proof of legal employment status for immigration

You may need an OFW Pass if you are:
- A first-time OFW with a verified contract
- A returning OFW (Balik-Manggagawa) with a new employer or job site
- An OFW returning to the same employer (for exemption/travel pass generation)

content.title: Benefits of Having an OFW Pass

blocks.content: The transition to the digital OFW Pass makes processing faster and more convenient.

blocks.title: Free of Charge
blocks.content: The DMW has moved to make the digital OFW Pass free, saving workers money.

blocks.title: Entirely Paperless
blocks.content: You can present the QR code directly from your smartphone at the airport. No need for physical stamping or long queues at the DMW office.

blocks.title: Online Application (DMW Mobile App)
blocks.content: This is the primary and recommended method for 2026.

blocks.title: eGovPH App
blocks.content: You can also access your OFW Pass through the unified Philippine government app, **eGovPH**, under the NGA > DMW section.
**Pro Tip:** The **DMW Mobile App** is now the primary portal for OEC and e-Registration. Ensure your profile is 100% complete before booking appointments.

blocks.title: Register for E-Registration
blocks.content: If you don't have one, create an account on the [DMW Online Services Portal](https://onlineservices.dmw.gov.ph). Ensure all profile details (Experience, Education, etc.) are complete.

blocks.title: Download the DMW Mobile App
blocks.content: Install the app from the Google Play Store or Apple App Store and log in using your E-Registration credentials.

blocks.title: Identity Verification
blocks.content: Upload a photo of your passport. The app will use facial recognition or database cross-referencing to verify your identity.

blocks.title: Apply for OFW Pass
blocks.content: Input your visa details and upload a photo of your valid work visa. The DMW will verify these against their records.

blocks.title: Generate QR Code
blocks.content: Once your status turns **Green**, your OFW Pass QR code will be generated. Save a screenshot of this QR code on your phone.

Applicants may process their OFW Pass at:
- [DMW Mobile App](https://www.dmw.gov.ph)
- [eGovPH App](https://e.gov.ph)
- [DMW Online Services Portal](https://onlineservices.dmw.gov.ph)

Typical processing timelines include:
*   Verified Records: Instant to 24 Hours
*   Manual Verification: 1–3 Working Days

Applicants may monitor their application through:
*   The DMW Mobile App (Status Indicator: Green/Yellow/Red)
*   Email notifications from the DMW portal

Applicants may experience:
- **Record Mismatch:** Differences between your passport name and E-Registration profile.
- **Verification Delays:** High volume of applications or unclear document uploads.

items: **Incorrect Visa Type:** Uploading a tourist visa instead of a work visa.
**Incomplete Profile:** Not updating your latest contract details before applying.

blocks.content: Always review your QR code status at least 48 hours before your flight.

items: Keep your DMW E-Registration profile updated with your latest employer details.
Take passport and visa photos in a well-lit area with no shadows.
Use the same email address across all DMW and eGovPH platforms.

blocks.content: For the latest advisories on the OFW Pass and airport procedures, please refer to:

items: **Mobile App Support:** Check the DMW Mobile App "Help" section for technical assistance.

blocks.title: Do I still need to print the OEC?
blocks.content: No, the digital QR code on your phone is sufficient. However, having a printed backup is recommended for peace of mind.

blocks.title: What if my status is Red?
blocks.content: A Red status means there is an issue with your records (e.g., missing contract verification or expired medical). You must contact the DMW or your agency to resolve the issue.
